name: Why should I choose a design-build firm like AKN Design Group for my hardscaping project instead of separate contractors?

mainEntity.name: Why should I choose a design-build firm like AKN Design Group for my hardscaping project instead of separate contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing AKN Design Group for your hardscaping project provides the significant advantage of a single point of coordination. Unlike managing separate designers and contractors, our integrated design-build process unifies planning and construction under one experienced team. This streamlines communication, minimizes potential conflicts, and ensures that the design vision is executed precisely as intended, leading to a more efficient project, better accountability, and a higher quality outcome for your high-end outdoor living space.
